نتفاوت (form VI)
# نَتَفَاوَتُ (natafāwatu) /na.ta.faː.wa.tu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَفَاوَتَ (tafāwata)
# نَتَفَاوَتَ (natafāwata) /na.ta.faː.wa.ta/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَفَاوَتَ (tafāwata)
# نَتَفَاوَتْ (natafāwat) /na.ta.faː.wat/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَفَاوَتَ (tafāwata)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
